A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LD-SMC research work. All 24 pages in each version, including Appendices A–I, are available and readable; text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable assessment of equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original ImageNet and FFHQ reconstruction experiments in Section 5, alongside computational-cost measurements, ablations, and additional results in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original reconstruction experiments, computational-cost measurements, ablations, and quantitative and qualitative appendix results.

M1.justification: The generative model, Algorithm 1, initialization, Gibbs sampling, SMC weights, and proposal distributions are unchanged. Rewording Section 4 and specifying DDIM in Figure 1 clarify the existing procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ImageNet and FFHQ on box inpainting, free-form inpainting, Gaussian deblurring, and 8× super-resolution. The appendices retain the same task coverage and examples.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain LDPS, LTDS, ReSample, PSLD, PFLD, and LatentDAPS. Table 5 also retains the prior-proposal and DPS-proposal comparisons. Changing TDS citations from Wu et al. (2024) to (2023) does not change the comparator.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix A retain the same 1024-image evaluations, 256×256 resolution, diffusion models, observation noise, particle settings, metrics, and hyperparameter-selection procedures. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The sensitivity analyses for s and particle count in Figure 5, Gibbs-iteration analysis in Figure 6, proposal ablation in Table 5, and auxiliary-observation visualization in Figure 7 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report computational-cost averages over 10 trials in Appendix E. Repeated-run disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged, with no added seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The quantitative results and qualitative reconstructions are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, five-particle LD-SMC box-inpainting FID remains 50.67 on ImageNet and 33.87 on FFHQ in Tables 2 and 1, respectively.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, equations, Theorem 4.1, and derivations and proofs in Appendices B–D are unchanged. Appendix C only updates the year of the same Wu et al. reference.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the same contributions: auxiliary observations for latent diffusion, tailored SMC targets and proposals, asymptotic accuracy, and improved perceptual quality particularly for inpainting. The abstract and conclusion preserve these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of auxiliary-observation guidance, perceptual-versus-distortion tradeoffs, reconstruction artifacts, and computational limitations remain unchanged, including the appendix discussions.

D1.justification: v3 removes the Introduction's explicit public-code statement and LD-SMC repository link without providing replacement access information elsewhere. Implementation details, hardware, hyperparameters, and timing information remain unchanged. This establishes reduced access documentation, not withdrawal of the repository itself.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are unchanged. Wu et al.'s existing conditional-sampling reference changes from 2024 to 2023 and gains a page range; this is a bibliographic correction.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited terminology and prose edits, including replacing several instances of 'backward' with 'reverse,' clarifying latent variables and the Section 4 overview, and correcting reference metadata. The correspondence email changes, while section and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption now specifies the DDIM forward process and uses 'reverse diffusion.' Small text reflows accompany the edits and code-link removal; illustrations, plots, table structures, and their placements remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 offers small wording clarifications and a bibliographic correction, but removes the explicit code-availability statement and repository link from the Introduction. With the scientific content and experimental evidence unchanged, losing this direct implementation-access information produces a limited net decline in reproducibility documentation. The PDFs do not establish whether the repository itself remains available.
